## Repository maintenance / 仓库维护

Type label / 类型标签: `type:maintenance` (maintainer confirms / 维护者确认)

- Scope and reason / 范围与原因:
- Checks performed / 已做检查:
- Affected existing tasks (if any) / 受影响已有任务（如有）:

- [ ] No new tasks or scientific/scoring changes. / 不新增任务，不混入科学内容或评分逻辑变更。
- [ ] No secrets or unauthorized materials. / 无 Secret 或未授权材料。

No Proposal required. Review on GitHub only; do not register this on the website task PR board. / 无需 Proposal，仅在 GitHub 审核，不登记到网站任务 PR 看板。
